text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am. Since I was off yesterday, I
went to a
farmers' market to pick up
some vegetables.
choice_data_list_en: You're in quite a good mood, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There, I ran into Nature and Ikuno, so we
decided
to do our shopping together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We all picked out some juicy fruits of
the earth,
then whipped up some nice
dishes together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It was quite an eventful day, but
my time
off felt akin to a sunlit breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Yamanin Zephyr fully
enjoyed her
day off warms my heart.
